menuImageUrls.title: Menu image or PDF URLs
menuImageUrls.description: Publicly accessible URLs of menu images (JPG, PNG, WEBP) or PDF files to digitize. One output record per dish is produced per page.

geminiApiKey.title: Gemini API key
geminiApiKey.description: Your own Google Gemini API key (free tier: https://aistudio.google.com). The Actor calls Gemini on YOUR key, so the actor owner pays nothing for AI inference. Treat this as a secret.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Language for translated dish names and ingredient display names (ISO 639-1 code or name, e.g. 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'es', 'it').

sourceLanguageHint.title: Source language hint
sourceLanguageHint.description: Optional hint about the menu's language/script (e.g. 'ja', 'th', 'ar', 'hi') to improve extraction on non-Latin menus.

cuisineVertical.title: Cuisine vertical
cuisineVertical.description: Loads a cuisine-specific EU-14 allergen keyword override map for higher allergen accuracy on ethnic menus.

maxPagesPerPdf.title: Max PDF pages
maxPagesPerPdf.description: Cap on the number of PDF pages rendered per PDF file (protects against huge menus).

jurisdiction.title: Allergen jurisdiction
jurisdiction.description: Regulatory regime for allergen labeling. 'EU' applies EU Regulation 1169/2011 (14 allergens).
